"""Integrate the completed max saved analysis without reopening the original trial."""

import gzip
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path("/workspaces/quoridor")
BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OWN = (
    ROOT
    / ".worktree/arena-generalization377/.artifacts/research-team/lmr-game-analysis415-v1"
)
DEST = ROOT / "research-data/ai-sigma/lmr-game-analysis415"
OUT = BASE / "publication-v2"
loader = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
    "lc", ROOT / "scripts/dev/research-lifecycle.py"
)
lc = importlib.util.module_from_spec(loader)
sys.modules["lc"] = lc
loader.loader.exec_module(lc)


def main():
    OUT.mkdir()
    completion_ref = lc.artifact_ref(OWN / "completion.json")
    assert (
        completion_ref["sha256"]
        == "6b4e2be6957e6fb388b503ea5478431ae989d0a6f3cc88b013e153cde838b6ac"
    )
    assert completion_ref["bytes"] == 11830
    completion = lc.document(completion_ref)
    assert (
        completion["model"],
        completion["effort"],
        completion["sandbox"],
        completion["approvalPolicy"],
    ) == ("gpt-6.1-sol", "max", "danger-full-access", "never")
    assert completion["strong_causality_or_general_strength_new_claims"] == []
    assert completion["fixed_examples"] == 12 and completion["first_divergences"] == 196
    assert completion["census"] == dict(
        games=392,
        pairs=196,
        shared_families=98,
        accepted=20285,
        completed_snapshots=20284,
        fallback=1,
    )
    assert completion["canonical_current_status"]["status_after"] == "closed"
    assert completion["canonical_current_status"]["assignee_unchanged"]
    assert completion["canonical_current_status"]["backup_sync_exit0"]
    assert completion["owned"] == completion["TMP"] == completion["leases"] == []
    assert completion["new_native_Search_model_solver_games_bootstrap_fit"] == 0
    for ref in completion["refs"].values():
        assert lc.artifact_ref(ref["path"]) == ref
    findings = lc.document(completion["refs"]["findings.json"])
    assert findings["new_important_causality_or_strength_claims"] == []
    assert len(findings["next_minimum_proposals"]) == 3
    assert all(
        not row["authorized_execution"] for row in findings["next_minimum_proposals"]
    )
    foreign = lc.artifact_ref(ROOT / ".devcontainer/update-toolchain.sh")
    assert (
        foreign["sha256"]
        == "19e82f23d60324251dcfed285cc95c48a9c3a4fec98cb87fa8e5a80d87b34b93"
    )
    accepted = lc.document(lc.artifact_ref(BASE / "analysis-acceptance.json"))
    assert accepted["completion"] == completion_ref
    archive = BASE / "publication-v1/saved-analysis.json.gz"
    archived = json.loads(gzip.decompress(archive.read_bytes()))
    assert archived["issue"] == "quoridor-4lc.415"
    files = archived["files"]
    assert DEST.exists() and set(p.name for p in DEST.iterdir()) == {archive.name}
    public_archive = DEST / archive.name
    assert (
        lc.artifact_ref(public_archive)["sha256"] == lc.artifact_ref(archive)["sha256"]
    )
    # V1 completed exact archive verification before cross-device hardlink failed.
    # Resume only the remaining copy/publication; do not re-extract RAW or re-export.
    # Immutable generated tables retain producer bytes across distinct filesystems.
    table_names = [
        "examples-ja.md",
        "families-ja.md",
        "family-table.csv",
        "game-table.csv",
        "condition-table.csv",
        "colour-table.csv",
        "work-table.csv",
        "depth-table.csv",
        "analysis-tables.json",
        "first-divergences.json",
        "examples.json",
        "verification.json",
        "STOP.json",
        "completion.json",
        "closure.json",
    ]
    for name in table_names:
        shutil.copy2(OWN / name, DEST / name)
        before_ref = lc.artifact_ref(OWN / name)
        after_ref = lc.artifact_ref(DEST / name)
        assert all(before_ref[k] == after_ref[k] for k in ("sha256", "bytes", "mode"))
    repair_files = []
    for p in [
        BASE / "publish-final-v2.py",
        BASE / "guard-publication-v2.py",
        *sorted((BASE / "export-publication-guard-v1").glob("*.json")),
        *sorted((BASE / "export-publication-guard-v1").glob("*.log")),
    ]:
        ref = lc.artifact_ref(p)
        repair_files.append(dict(ref, text=lc.read_ref(ref, ref["bytes"]).decode()))
    lc.new_json(
        DEST / "publication-repair.json",
        dict(
            scope="Ordinary cross-device publication fix only; v1 archive and its exact roundtrip completed before EXDEV. Retain failed controller/captures, resume remaining tables with copy2+SHA-size-mode, no RAW/analysis/science replay.",
            files=repair_files,
        ),
    )
    tail = "\n\n元412の完了・区間・選択は変更せず、本415は保存解析だけを追加した。max本人のanalysis snapshotと、その後の本人close/backupをcompletion/closureで区別する。原参照・小抽出・helper・失敗・費用・停止証拠は[receipt](receipt.json)とsaved-analysis.json.gzに保存した。Root統合による新しいRAW decode/Search/対局/model/solver/bootstrapは0。\n"
    (DEST / "report-ja.md").write_text((OWN / "report-ja.md").read_text() + tail)
    lc.new_json(
        DEST / "receipt.json",
        dict(
            issue="quoridor-4lc.415",
            model="gpt-6.1-sol",
            effort="max",
            original_trial="quoridor-4lc.412 publication367fc042, original imagebb63fc17/Build e934c534; original392 completion and CI unchanged",
            original_trial_receipt=lc.artifact_ref(
                ROOT / "research-data/ai-sigma/lmr-standard412/receipt.json"
            ),
            author_completion=completion_ref,
            author_closure=completion["refs"]["closure.json"],
            analysis_acceptance=lc.artifact_ref(BASE / "analysis-acceptance.json"),
            archive=lc.artifact_ref(public_archive),
            exact_files=len(files),
            archive_roundtrip="PASS SHA-size-mode/UTF8-or-binary exact",
            tables=[lc.artifact_ref(DEST / n) for n in table_names],
            ordinary_publication_repair=lc.artifact_ref(
                DEST / "publication-repair.json"
            ),
            census=completion["census"],
            fixed_examples=12,
            first_divergences=196,
            important_new_causality_or_general_strength_claims=[],
            independent_review_of_own_analysis=False,
            future_proposals_only=findings["next_minimum_proposals"],
            RAW_reader_STOP=completion["RAW_reader_STOP"],
            RAW_directwait_reap=completion["RAW_directwait_reap"],
            compact_reader_STOP=completion["compact_reader_STOP"],
            compact_directwait_reap=completion["compact_directwait_reap"],
            original412_outer_seconds_charged_again=0,
            full_fees_continuous_RSS_physical_NN="UNKNOWN",
            new_Search_games_solver_model_bootstrap_fit=0,
        ),
    )
    body = """
### 可変LMR追加392局のmax保存分析（415、2026-10-15）

人間指定のGPT-6.1 Sol/maxで、完了済み412の392局・196色pair・共有98開始系統について、条件/先後・最初の着手分岐・探索配分を解析した。原試験はA=fixed_one/B=depth_rank、Control/TT1M/100ms receipt/5ms reserve、旧408 image bb63fc17/Build e934c534で、新standard/413 imageとは別。元主要NNUE106勝90敗・score54.08%・95%区間46.94–61.22%、副次固定D99勝97敗・50.51%・45.41–55.61%と下限>50%未達を保ち、CI/選択/元完了の再審査や新bootstrapはしていない。

全98系統のB両色勝ち/片勝ち/両色負けはNNUE31/44/23、固定D14/71/13。B=P0/P1の勝ちはNNUE51/55、固定D51/48（各色98局）。開始prefix4/8/12/16の層と実在庫別も保存したが小さい探索的部分群で、優越・有意層・次の有利条件選別には使わない。同じ98系統の依存を保つ。全196pairで、開始rootと完全保存履歴・共有prefix・手番の一致後に着手が分かれた。初分岐でBが深い/同深さ/浅い/欠測はNNUE1/65/31/1、固定D1/65/32/0。同value bitsはNNUE0/97完成比較、固定D35/98。内部TT/killer/history/先行探索・worker/時計の一致と一手のoracleはUNKNOWNで、LMR単独の因果比較や「深く読んだから勝った」とはしない。

RAW抽出前に結果群ごとの既存ID順先頭3系統を固定した最大12例は全てprefix4で、補充0。全98系統表、全392局、8色別行、196初分岐と12例のgame/family/ply/RAW行-offset-SHA/PV/value/stop/実続行先頭8/勝者を保存した。NNUE family5のA合法fallback一件（完成snapshotなし）も原分母から除かず、原因を誤削減・forward不実行等へ断定しない。

accepted20285/完成snapshot20284を維持。完成深さ中央値はNNUE A/B6/6、固定D11/11だが、深さ4以下はNNUE1580/2008、固定D545/1177件。正のroot在庫では中央値NNUE5/4・固定D6/5、零在庫では21/20・20/20と深い尾部が混ざる。BのLMR trialは少ないが、terminal nodesはNNUE A433.258M/B436.979M、固定D920.830M/966.886Mで、評価数もBが多い。異なる軌跡/実手数/選択木の観測であり、仕事当たり速度や強さの因果ではない。採用snapshot後の仕事とterminal/profile/LMR/PVSを重複加算せず、branch rank/実q/静的候補値、physical NN、連続RSS、孤立部位費はUNKNOWN。

重要な単独原因・一般棋力優越の新主張は0。優先度付き次候補は、同履歴rootでのq/rank/確認/採用後反復の対応、family5一応答の準備/receipt/cancel制御時系列、固定D同値bits異着手の順位/推定値分離の最大3つで、提案のみ・未実行。原392のgzip各一回stream後は小抽出だけを使い、新Search/対局/model/solver/bootstrap/fitは0。137集計view/分割和/12例の自身の整合確認は独立レビューではなく、新しい重要因果主張がない範囲で保存観測として受け入れた。本人415.1は検証close/backup済み。

一度RAW抽出の自己計時2.209739241秒とguard2.268412267秒はnestedで足さず、元412 outer2017.211898980秒を再課金しない。全source/LLM/admin費はUNKNOWN。実RAW readerSTOP10:51:23.370580Z/直接reap.479383、小抽出STOP11:21:46.693394Z/reap.698934と全FAILED/STOP/owned[]を保持した。[詳細報告・全表・固定12例](../research-data/ai-sigma/lmr-game-analysis415/report-ja.md)。人間選択の研究LMR ON/depth_rank、製品/generator enable OFF、全mixed/learner prep/pipeline・323 USERPAUSE、models/weights/seals/oldfits96/foreign変更を維持する。414の壁迂回は別の計画限定scope。
"""
    docs = [
        ROOT / "docs/research-findings.md",
        ROOT / "docs/design/lightweight-move-ordering-v1.md",
    ]
    before = []
    for path in docs:
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        assert (
            "### 可変LMR追加392局のmax保存分析（415、2026-10-15）" not in raw.decode()
        )
        before.append((path, raw))
        text = (
            body.replace("../research-data/", "../../research-data/")
            if path.parent.name == "design"
            else body
        )
        path.write_bytes(raw + text.encode())
    selected = [DEST / "report-ja.md", DEST / "receipt.json", *docs]
    formatter = [
        "/home/vscode/.local/bin/node",
        str(ROOT / "tools/research-quality/node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs"),
        "--config",
        str(ROOT / "tools/research-quality/.prettierrc.json"),
        "--ignore-path",
        "/dev/null",
    ]
    for mode in ("--write", "--check"):
        subprocess.run([*formatter, mode, *map(str, selected)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    for path, raw in before:
        assert path.read_bytes().startswith(raw)
    assert lc.artifact_ref(foreign["path"]) == foreign
    # Generated tables and all frozen author evidence are byte-preserved.
    for ref in completion["refs"].values():
        assert lc.artifact_ref(ref["path"]) == ref
    roots = [BASE, OWN, DEST, *docs]
    seen = set()
    allocated = sum(lc.allocated(path, seen=seen) for path in roots)
    prior = 49237598208
    assert prior + allocated < 50000000000
    lc.new_json(
        DEST / "postwork-usage.json",
        dict(
            at=lc.stamp(),
            roots=list(map(str, roots)),
            allocated_B=allocated,
            prior_conservative_covered_upper_B=prior,
            conservative_sum_B=prior + allocated,
            global_actual_B=None,
            storage_budget=None,
            scope="Directed whole415 once/inode dedup before usage/Git/final admin tail. Author snapshot included not added twice; shared original412 RAW/image/models/Cargo not copied or recharged. Includes affected existing docs conservatively, historical overlap possible; no global assets walk/refund.",
        ),
    )
    selected.append(DEST / "postwork-usage.json")
    for mode in ("--write", "--check"):
        subprocess.run([*formatter, mode, str(selected[-1])], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    selected.extend(
        [
            public_archive,
            DEST / "publication-repair.json",
            *[DEST / n for n in table_names],
        ]
    )
    subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--cached", "--exit-code"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "add", "--", *map(str, selected)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    staged = subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "diff", "--cached", "--name-only"], cwd=ROOT, text=True
    ).splitlines()
    assert set(staged) == {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in selected}
    subprocess.run(
        [
            "git",
            "commit",
            "-m",
            "Record max analysis of saved LMR games and first divergences",
        ],
        cwd=ROOT,
        check=True,
    )
    commit = subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, text=True
    ).strip()
    lc.new_json(
        OUT / "result.json",
        dict(
            at=lc.stamp(),
            commit=commit,
            publication=[lc.artifact_ref(p) for p in selected],
            acceptance=lc.artifact_ref(BASE / "analysis-acceptance.json"),
            foreign_unchanged=foreign,
            author_refs_unchanged=True,
            new_Search_games_models_solver_bootstrap_fit=0,
        ),
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Run the one named415 composition through the maintained process guard."""

import importlib.util
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys

ROOT = Path("/workspaces/quoridor")
BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
loader = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
    "lc", ROOT / "scripts/dev/research-lifecycle.py"
)
lc = importlib.util.module_from_spec(loader)
sys.modules["lc"] = lc
loader.loader.exec_module(lc)
OUT = BASE / "export-publication-guard-v2"
OUT.mkdir()
tmp = OUT / "TMP"
tmp.mkdir()
spec = dict(
    kind="source",
    cwd=str(ROOT),
    TMP=str(tmp),
    env=dict(
        os.environ,
        TMPDIR=str(tmp),
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="",
        PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1",
        OMP_NUM_THREADS="1",
        OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
    ),
    limits=dict(
        worker_cpu=12,
        guardian_cpu=16,
        family_B=768 * 1024**2,
        controller_B=64 * 1024**2,
        host_reserve_B=4 * 1024**3,
        log_B=2 * 1024**2,
    ),
)
checks = []
primary = None
try:
    lc.physical_and_quiet(spec)
    resources = lc.process.CycleResources(
        dict(max_memory_bytes=768 * 1024**2, host_ram_reserve=4 * 1024**3), OUT, None
    )
    with lc.lease():
        lc.command(
            spec,
            dict(
                name="preserve-and-publish415",
                role="source",
                argv=[
                    str(lc.project_python()),
                    "-B",
                    str(BASE / "publish-final-v2.py"),
                ],
            ),
            OUT,
            resources,
            executor=lambda *a, **kw: lc.process.execute(*a, **kw, no_new_privs=True),
            ledger=checks,
        )
except BaseException as error:
    primary = lc.error_fact(error)
    raise
finally:
    lc.new_json(OUT / "returned-receipt.json", dict(checks=checks, primary=primary))
    identities = []
    for check in checks:
        guardian = check.get("guardian_return")
        if guardian and guardian.get("child"):
            now = lc.process.identity(lc.process.process_info(guardian["child"]["pid"]))
            assert now != guardian["child"]
            identities.append(dict(original=guardian["child"], current=now))
    shutil.rmtree(tmp)
    lc.new_json(
        OUT / "STOP.json",
        dict(
            at=lc.stamp(),
            primary=primary,
            identities=identities,
            TMP_absent=True,
            owned_readers_children_jobs_handles_leases=[],
        ),
    )
